results.title: Goldman Sachs to acquire ETF manager NEOS in $2.25B deal
results.summary: The deal would add NEOS’ $30 billion ETF business, including Bitcoin- and Ether-linked income funds, to Goldman Sachs Asset Management.

results.title: Fidelity files with SEC to add staking to Ethereum ETF
results.summary: Fidelity plans to add staking to its Ether fund, with 85% of rewards retained by FETH and quarterly cash distributions planned for investors.

results.title: Russia moves to restrict retail crypto trading to bitcoin, ether and USDT
results.summary: Non-qualified investors face a 300,000-ruble (approx. $3,600) annual purchase limit per intermediary, while qualified investors have no cap.
